name: csle_level9_compact_attacker_action_space
description: Compact manifest for predicting a CSLE executable level9 attacker action sequence. The model should select high-level CSLE actions, not shell commands.

allowed_actions.role: Refresh reachable hosts before a new attack stage.
Optional port discovery when port scan evidence exists.
Optional vulnerability scan when vulnerability-scan evidence exists.
Optional Nmap vulners scan when vulners evidence exists.
Core exploit for SambaCry; should usually be followed by SERVICE_LOGIN.
Core SSH password guessing; should usually be followed by SERVICE_LOGIN.
Local privilege escalation after SSH login when privilege escalation is inferred.
Core DVWA SQL injection; should usually be followed by SERVICE_LOGIN.
Core Elasticsearch CVE-2015-1427 exploit; should usually be followed by SERVICE_LOGIN.
CSLE state update action. Required after credential/backdoor-producing actions to update logged_in/root and active connections.
CSLE pivot preparation action. Use after SERVICE_LOGIN before using a compromised host as a later jump host.
Optional backdoor install only if backdoor installation is inferred.
Use only if Telnet password guessing is inferred.
Use only if FTP password guessing is inferred.
Use only if ShellShock exploitation is inferred.
Use only if ProFTPD CVE-2015-3306 exploitation is inferred.
Use only if PHPMailer CVE-2016-10033 exploitation is inferred.
Use only if CVE-2015-5602 local privilege escalation is inferred.

csle_runtime_patterns: Before a major new exploit stage, add PING_SCAN(all) if reachability must be discovered/refreshed.
After SAMBACRY_EXPLOIT(samba), add SERVICE_LOGIN(all), and add INSTALL_TOOLS(all) if Samba is used as a pivot.
After SSH_SAME_USER_PASS_DICTIONARY(ssh), add SERVICE_LOGIN(all); if privilege escalation is inferred, add CVE_2010_0426_PRIV_ESC(ssh).
Before DVWA_SQL_INJECTION(dvwa), the sequence should already have a usable pivot: SERVICE_LOGIN(all) and usually INSTALL_TOOLS(all).
After DVWA_SQL_INJECTION(dvwa), add SERVICE_LOGIN(all), and add INSTALL_TOOLS(all) if DVWA is used as a pivot.
Before CVE_2015_1427_EXPLOIT(elasticsearch), the sequence should already have a usable pivot: SERVICE_LOGIN(all) and usually INSTALL_TOOLS(all).
After CVE_2015_1427_EXPLOIT(elasticsearch), add SERVICE_LOGIN(all); add INSTALL_TOOLS(all) if later actions continue.
selection_rules: Choose only action values from allowed_actions.action.
Choose only target aliases allowed for that action.
Do not use service names such as SSH, DVWA, or ELASTICSEARCH as action values. They are targets: ssh, dvwa, elasticsearch.
Output a CSLE executable sequence, not only a semantic list of exploits.
Do not output Docker commands, shell commands, exploit script paths, or recovery actions.
